label: Column
purpose: A single content card — meaning depends on which section it's in: a testimonial (testimonials), an icon/feature column (icon-bar), or a social-post-style testimonial with comments (facebook-testimonials)
_notes:
One block type shared by 3 different real components — only use the fields for the section this block is actually in, never mix them: (1) In testimonials: title, text, star_rating, author, author_avatar, image/video. (2) In icon-bar: icon, filled_icon, title, text, image. (3) In facebook-testimonials: post_author, post_author_avatar, post_time, post_text, post_image, post_reactions, post_reactions_text, post_comments_text, plus comment_1_*/comment_2_* for the two reply comments. 'text'/'post_text'/comment '_text' fields are richtext and MUST be wrapped in

tags; 'author'/'post_time'/comment '_time' are inline_richtext (no

tags). Leave every image/video/avatar field empty '' — media is filled in outside of you. In custom-columns-new, 'column' is a plain layout container instead — leave all these settings out for that section.
